cards.title: Make Your Application Stronger
cards.body: Getting ready for a mortgage? Start by focusing on the details lenders may review. 5 ways to prepare: 1️⃣ Pay bills on time 2️⃣ Keep debt levels manageable 3️⃣ Save for closing costs 4️⃣ Gather tax, income, and employment documents 5️⃣ Talk to a broker before making big financial changes Your Mortgage Alliance Professional can help you move forward with more clarity.

cards.title: First Home, Clear Next Steps
cards.body: Your first mortgage is more than a rate. It is a decision that affects your budget, lifestyle, and next few years as a homeowner. With Your Mortgage Alliance Professional, you can get support with: • Understanding your affordability • Getting pre-approved • Reviewing lender options • Planning for closing costs • Moving forward with confidence Let’s help you start your homebuying journey the right way.

title: Make Your Renewal Count
body: A lot can change before your mortgage renews. Your income, goals, payments, and plans may look different now. The right broker can help you find a better fit for this next chapter.
